title: Frequency reuse and free-space path loss
instructions:
## Planning a cellular network

An operator has **420** duplex channels and uses a cluster size of **N = 7**.

1. Channels available per cell.
2. The co-channel reuse ratio D/R = √(3N), to two decimals.
3. The system capacity (simultaneous calls) with 100 cells.
4. Channels per cell if the cluster size is reduced to N = 4.
5. The free-space path loss at 1 km and 900 MHz, in dB: 20·log₁₀(d_km) + 20·log₁₀(f_MHz) + 32.44.
hints: Channels per cell = total channels ÷ cluster size.
realityNote: Smaller clusters mean more capacity but more co-channel interference, which is why real plans use sectoring and measured path-loss models (Okumura–Hata) rather than free space; a 4G cell in Accra also reuses the same spectrum far more aggressively through OFDMA.
